profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Cboe Global Markets | M.S. Computer Science | B.S. Computer Science & Data Science | B.A. Mathematics
profile.summary: Hi there! I'm a Software Engineer with 1 YoE building scalable backend systems in Java and Python. I currently work on the Data Pipeline Engineering team at CBOE, where I develop Java applications for Snowflake integration and Kafka streaming services, and Python for symbol processing and data workflows. I'm also interested in enhancing existing services by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs). Always open to collaborations - feel free to reach out at eric.vu3339@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a comprehensive University Management System (UMS) using the LAMP (Linux, Apache, MariaDB/MySQL, PHP) stack, harnessing the power of these technologies to streamline administrative tasks and effectively manage student and university staff, significantly improving overall operational efficiency.
• Improved website performance by optimizing page speed, reducing loading time from 9 seconds to 5 seconds, resulting in a 44% increase in user engagement.
• Achieved substantial cost savings by research alternative servers provider solutions, reducing monthly expenses from $80 to $6, resulting in an 88% reduction in hosting costs.
• Successfully led the end-to-end development and hosting of the University Management System on Apache2 server with Cloudflare DNS, ensuring high availability and reliability.
• Led and mentored an intern to work collaboratively on the project, effectively leveraging FlutterFlow and Flutter to design and develop the mobile app rapidly, ensuring seamless teamwork and efficient project delivery.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Content Distribution Networks · Laravel · PhpMyAdmin · Cloudflare · WordPress · Apache

positions.title: Technical Services Intern
positions.description:
• Explored large language models for technical support chatbots, conducted market research, and provided recommendations for future integration.
• Revamped Power BI reports and created an integrated Power App, improving user accessibility and data updating capabilities.
• Orchestrated a comprehensive evaluation of Power Automate options for importing data to source file. Achieved 1,300% increase in data entry efficiency, elevating the rate from 3 rows per minute to 42 rows per minute, revolutionizing workflow operations. 
• Witnessed the immediate impact of contributions within the technical support team, gaining hands-on experience in technology application.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Power BI · Microsoft Power Automate · Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Built a full stack keyboard extension app incorporating OpenAI's GPT-3 model using Swift (Frontend), and Nest.JS (Backend).
•	Enhance web-based application security and performance through deployment of Cloudflare hosting server and Nginx.
•	Implemented authentication and authorization using Java web-based tokens and installed SSL certificates to ensure secure transmission of sensitive data.
•	Achieved real-time product delivery through an efficient CI/CD pipeline using Docker, Github Action, and server’s side Webhook, reducing release cycles by 80%.
•	Boosted user engagement by integrating GPT-3 model in a portable keyboard extension for immediate search results, resulting in a 140% increase in active users within the first week of release.
•	Implemented MySQL to manage user data and monitor token usage for real-time insights and informed decision making.
•	Consistently achieved 5000+ downloads with a steady weekly increase of 10 downloads on a digital produc

projects.title: RIVER SAVER: Robot that helps to collect floating debris on rivers, lakes
projects.description:
• Utilized Computer Vision, CAD designs, and electronics to help collecting floating debris on the river.
• Integrated Yolov4-tiny architecture on mobile phone (Android) to detect debris
• Acquired an eco-friendly way of collecting floating debris using paddle instead of electronics gate
• Authored research report & presented the project to committees in Intel Science and Engineering Contest

projects.title: STEW: Steps To End Wastes
projects.description:
• Built and designed application that provide incentives to the users for enacting eco-friendly choices
• Implemented Google's Xception neural network model with Tensorflow and Tensorflow Lite on mobile 
platform using Android Studio and published on Google CH Play store
• Created a community of up to 70 users to share their environment saving results
• Authored research report & presented the project to committees in Intel Science and Engineering Contest
